purpose: Part 4/5 of verified exact 50-record item effect batch 030; together these files contain exactly 50 reviewed records from the 80-record checkpoint.

items/master-of-the-east-wind-carpet.name: Master of the East Wind Carpet
items/master-of-the-east-wind-carpet.effectSummary: This intelligent lawful-neutral 5-foot-by-5-foot carpet of flying has Int 10, Wis 13, Cha 13, empathy, 60-foot vision and hearing, Ego 3, and 10 ranks in Spot for a +11 total modifier. In combat it generally directs its own movement with two move actions, leaving its master free to take other actions instead of spending a move action directing the carpet.

items/mind-blade-595.name: Mind Blade
items/mind-blade-595.effectSummary: A soulknife can create the mind blade as a move action. It is equivalent to a shortsword sized for the wielder, uses normal Strength bonuses, has hardness 10 and 10 hp, and dissipates when released unless thrown; if broken or lost the soulknife can make another on a later move action. It counts as a magic weapon for overcoming damage reduction, can be used with normal weapon feats, and can receive weapon-enhancing spells or powers. Its enhancement bonus scales with soulknife level: +1 at 4th, +2 at 8th, +3 at 12th, +4 at 16th, +5 at 20th. In a psionics-negating area, DC 20 Will maintains it for rounds equal to class level; on failure it vanishes, and the soulknife can attempt another DC 20 Will save as a move action on later turns to rematerialize it.

items/moon-owl.name: Moon Owl
items/moon-owl.effectSummary: Putting on the mask lets its Ego possess the wearer to locate, travel to, and destroy the nearest hostile creature; possession ends when the wearer is slain or returns victorious, after which the wearer collapses unconscious. If the wearer is killed, the mask teleports back to its village. The item is intelligent (Int 12, Wis 18, Cha 18; speech, telepathy, read languages, read magic, darkvision/blindsense/hearing 120 ft.; Ego 23). It can use bless three times per day, cure moderate wounds three times per day, locate creature three times per day, teleport twice per day, and greater shout for 15d6 damage three times per day; it also has 10 ranks in Listen for +14 total and has the special purpose of defending the bhukas.

items/najjars-cloak-of-weaponry.name: Najjar's Cloak of Weaponry
items/najjars-cloak-of-weaponry.effectSummary: Once per round, the wearer can withdraw one stored item from the cloak. It functions like a bag of holding but stores only up to 23 pounds of nonliving material whose volume can reasonably fit under a 6-foot-long cloak; most two-handed weapons do not fit unless they can be coiled or folded, while light and one-handed weapons generally do. Unlike a bag of holding, puncturing the cloak does not trigger the usual bag-of-holding destruction effects.

items/piwafwi-greater.name: Piwafwi, Greater
items/piwafwi-greater.effectSummary: This cloak has all abilities of a cloak of elvenkind and additionally provides fire protection equivalent to endure elements, negating 5 points of fire damage per round.

items/piwafwi-lesser-or-greater.name: Piwafwi, Lesser or Greater
items/piwafwi-lesser-or-greater.effectSummary: A lesser piwafwi functions as a cloak of elvenkind. A greater piwafwi also functions as a cloak of elvenkind and provides fire protection equivalent to endure elements, negating 5 points of fire damage per round.

items/powerstones-691.name: Power Stones
items/powerstones-691.effectSummary: A power stone stores one or more psionic powers, each usable once. It must first be addressed with Psicraft DC 15 + power level; after that, using a stored power requires holding the stone and willing the power as normal, usually a standard action and subject to disruption. The user must have the power on their class list and the required key ability score. If the user's manifester level meets or exceeds the stone's, activation succeeds automatically; otherwise make a manifester-level check against DC stone ML + 1. On failure, a DC 5 Wisdom check avoids brainburn, and a natural 1 always fails. Brainburn lasts 1d4 rounds unless the stone is destroyed or moved more than 100 feet away, dealing 1d6 damage per stored power each round to the user and one randomly chosen nearby ally. Standard stones use the minimum manifester level for their powers unless created otherwise, have AC 7, 5 hp, hardness 8, and break DC 20. Random stones are psion/wilder on 01-70 or psychic warrior on 71-100, hold 1d3/1d4/1d6 powers for minor/medium/major, and psychic-warrior stones reroll results above 6th level.

items/power-stones-1st-level-power-807.name: Power Stones 1st level Power
items/power-stones-1st-level-power-807.effectSummary: This is the 1st-level-power version of a power stone. It follows the normal power-stone rules: address it with Psicraft DC 16; the user must have the power on their class list and the required key ability score; if the user's manifester level is below the stone's, make a manifester-level check against DC stone ML + 1; a failed check can cause brainburn unless a DC 5 Wisdom check succeeds, with a natural 1 always failing. Brainburn lasts 1d4 rounds and deals 1d6 damage per stored power per round to the user and a random nearby ally until the stone is destroyed or more than 100 feet away. The stored power is single-use; standard stones use the minimum required manifester level. A typical power stone has AC 7, 5 hp, hardness 8, break DC 20, and the standard market price for a 1st-level power is 25 gp.

items/psicrownofthecrystalmind-705.name: Psicrown of the Crystal Mind
items/psicrownofthecrystalmind-705.effectSummary: The crown can spend its power points to manifest burst, catfall, greater concealing amorpha, concussion blast, psionic daze, detect psionics, psionic dominate, far hand, float, mindlink, inertial barrier, telekinetic force, telekinetic maneuver, telekinetic thrust, psionic teleport, thicken skin, or true metabolism at manifester level 20 or the wearer's manifester level if higher. The wearer gains power resistance equal to 10 + their manifester level. It is found with 1,000 power points; a wearer instantly knows the current total, and the crown regenerates 1 point per day while below 1,000. As a one-time standard action, the wearer can discharge all remaining points in an uncontrolled burst: creatures within 20 feet take damage equal to half the remaining power points, Reflex DC 18 half; the wearer is unharmed and the crown is permanently burned out.

items/psicrown-692.name: Psicrowns
items/psicrown-692.effectSummary: A psicrown normally begins with power points equal to 50 times its manifester level, usable only on the specific powers stored in that crown. It uses power-trigger activation, usually a standard action with no attack of opportunity, or the power's longer manifesting time if applicable. The wearer spends the crown's power points and may augment its powers with additional crown points up to the wearer's manifester level, but cannot add personal power points. Save DCs use the wearer's ability score and relevant feats, and the wearer may use their own manifester level if it is higher than the crown's. Minimum psicrown manifester level is 8th and cannot exceed by more than 5 the minimum manifester level required for its highest-level power. Typical metallic crowns are AC 10, 10 hp, hardness 8, break DC 28; reinforced-silk crowns are AC 7, 10 hp, hardness 2, break DC 24. On random generation, 01-30 gives mentally whispered operating instructions when donned, while 31-100 gives no special quality.
